claim.summary: Multilinear setting. For an F_p degree-D pseudoideal J containing old Boolean or F_p-domain consequences, w of degree<=b, U<=V_K and errors E_1..E_r of degree<=e, all with F_p coefficients, with b+K+e+(p-1)min(K,e)<=D, stacked rank rho of u->([wE_i u])_i and common kernel N: over F_q with q>rho, a uniform combination E(lambda)=sum lambda_i E_i has annihilator {u in U tensor F_q: wE(lambda)u in J tensor F_q} equal to N tensor F_q with probability >=1-rho/q, and rank rho; so the joint saving is sum rank_i minus one combination's rank. In a domain model (J the degree-D vanishing ideal of a finite X, w=1, K+e<=D) no reserve is needed: if the vectors (E_i(x))_i on the union of supports fall into h projective classes, some lambda over F_q with q>=h has support the union, and its annihilator is N tensor F_q. Over F_p no element of degree<=e need have annihilator N (p=2, {0,1}^3, D=4, U=V_2, errors x, y; x+omega*y over F_4 works, and x+y+xy of degree D-K over F_2). The joint-error-savings domination clause is ambiguous: read as a property over an extension it excludes every reserve-window and domain-model family.

significance.rationale: Shows the joint-savings endpoint's domination clause must be read at the base field and reduces a joint saving in the reserve window to one combination's rank.
significance.next_action: Upper bound on one generic combination's rank in Pang's window, checking descent of the approximators.

claim.summary: For an F_p degree-D pseudoideal containing old Boolean or F_p domains, fixed weight w of degree<=b, F_p-linear U<=V_K and actual F_p errors E_i of degree<=e, b+K+e+(p-1)min(K,e)<=D makes the generic pencil sum t_i(f->[wE_i f]) have exactly the stacked common kernel and rank r. Input-side Frobenius gives b+K+pe; multiplier-side p-power independence gives b+pK+e without powering w. Over any finite extension of cardinality q>r, a uniform specialization has the same kernel with probability>=1-r/q. If r<dim[wU], an original F_p multiplier in U survives and kills every error. This is a cheaper compression window, not a new joint-rank upper bound or an extension-valued scalar ENS substitution.
claim.assessment: Working all-prime proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer; input-side half is recorded Frobenius compression, multiplier-side half uses independence over rational pth powers. Prime-field base and fixed maps retained. No new joint-rank bound or contraction ceiling claimed.

claim.summary: Over any field, let C be a degree-D PC closure, w_1..w_r of degrees e_i<=e, Ann_K(w)={u in V_K: wu in C}, and s=sum_i a_i w_i with deg a_i+e_i<=K', deg s<=sigma, s w_i - w_i in C for every i, K+K'<=D and K+sigma+e<=D. Then intersection_i Ann_K(w_i)=Ann_K(s): the common kernel of the factor maps is one annihilator. Errors E_nu=h_nu w_{i(nu)}+(member) with deg h_nu<=g and K+e+g<=D have that common kernel inside theirs. In a domain model on a finite X with 0/1-valued w_i, s=1-prod(1-w_i) qualifies when K+(r+1)e<=D; for the pigeonhole hole axioms, w_i=x_ij (i in I) and s=sum_{i in I} x_ij qualify when K+2<=D.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in a staged review; the general per-index degrees and the remark that factorization through s=1 is vacuous are its corrections.

significance.rationale: Turns the route's non-domination requirement into a checkable condition: a joint saving among errors with shared factors needs truncation to block every affordable principal generator of their factor ideal. significance.next_action: Test the common kernels of factor families in the functional pigeonhole system at 7 pigeons, 6 holes, D=3, where the closure need not be a vanishing ideal.

claim.summary: Over any field F, for a finite set X in F^n, B_D the polynomials of degree <=D vanishing on X, U=V_K/(B_D cap V_K) and errors E_1..E_s of degree <=e with K+e<=D: the map u->[E_j u] in V_D/B_D has rank dim U|_{S_j}, S_j the support of E_j on X, and the stacked map has rank dim U|_S, S the union of the supports; the restriction U|_S -> direct sum of U|_{S_j} is injective, so the sum of ranks exceeds the stacked rank by its cokernel dimension. With X the Boolean cube over F_p this is the domain-only model of cor:pang-observation-calibration at Pang's cutoff Delta+K+d<=D, where every saving over the sum is a union-of-supports interpolation count; such savings carry into Pang's proper quotient since B_D is inside C_D.
claim.assessment: Working proof of the domain-model statement, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer. Its final transfer clause (savings carry into Pang's proper quotient since B_D is inside C_D) is corrected by ex:support-saving-not-inherited: only the inequality stacked proper rank <= dim U|_S follows.
